goal: Bake a portable memory-bearing agent mechanism by adapting MantleOS-inspired Anchor specimens into an explicit Python implementation, without automatically running emitted code or granting the MIND direct body authority.

target.description: A body-side memory interface that accepts approved intentions and persists history using explicit, append-only records
target.source: Original KPP teaching bake inspired by MantleOS concepts

preserve: Only admitted actions can cross the intent boundary
Existing records are never edited in-place
Acceptance is scoped to evidence for mandatory recipe Anchors
may_change: Memory substrate and physical cell representation
Implementation tissue when the Oven is configured for Python

oven.assumption: Consistent execution of sufficiently explicit recipe
oven.bridge: Anchor EMIT_TEXT/0.2 emits Python text; explicit host materialization required
oven.execution: no automatic execution of emitted code

acceptance: All required anchors must be tested and attested for this pinned recipe

anchors.statement: All selected portable Anchor specimens have valid primers and pass strict whole-document validation
anchors.test: kpp doctor and kpp anchor inspect on selected specimens

anchors.statement: Anchor specimens emit Python source reproducibly without automatically running it
anchors.test: kpp anchor bridge-python to fresh .py output; check hash; confirm no side effect until explicit execution

anchors.statement: The body rejects unrecognized actions and returns a bounded interpretation of allowed intentions
anchors.test: Run bridged intent-boundary.py with remember and overwrite JSON; only remember is admitted as proposal
preserves: Only admitted actions can cross the intent boundary

anchors.statement: Append-only memory preserves earlier records and detects modified record contents
anchors.test: Explicitly run bridged memory-ledger.py to append and read, then tamper and verify rejection
preserves: Existing records are never edited in-place

anchors.statement: Chase stops on tested, bounded target satisfaction and redirects otherwise
anchors.test: Run bridged chase-stop.py with accepted and rejected performance ratios and check statuses; check that KPP cannot mark a workspace complete until every required Anchor receives scoped acceptance evidence
preserves: Acceptance is scoped to evidence for mandatory recipe Anchors
